purpose: Backend transport/schema qualification using one existing-Specification control; not semantic accuracy estimation.

source.code:
WORKSPACE_ALLOCATION_SPEC: PredicateSpec[WorkspaceAllocationContext] = PredicateSpec(
    lambda context: (
        context.allocation["workspace_identity"] == context.requested_workspace_identity
        and context.allocation["source_ref"] == context.requested_source_ref
        and context.allocation["expected_commit"] == context.requested_expected_commit
        and context.allocation["identity_allocation_authorized"] is True
        and context.allocation["source_ref_initialization_authorized"] is True
        and context.allocation["declaration_sha256"] == context.requested_declaration_sha256
    ),
    name="subject_publication.workspace_allocation",
)

runtime_prerequisites: Separate user approval for one inference process.
Resolve executable and dedicated authenticated Codex home paths; no global AGENTS.md or AGENTS.override.md.
Regenerate prepared.json from the resolved configuration; record all digests before dispatch.
Use a fresh private run directory outside Git/project-config ancestry.

acceptance.transport: One completed CLI turn, no tool/config-error events, closed schema with all four answers; otherwise analysis_incomplete.
acceptance.semantic: Compare each proposed label with the frozen R01/baseline Sol comparator only after capture. Record disagreements; never accept facts automatically.
acceptance.quality_claim: No accuracy, repeatability, cost or speed claim from one selected control.

remaining_differences: Codex transport wrapper and labels-only structured output differ from historical API wire and Sol rationale format.
CLI/backend revisions and decoding may differ; returned model and provider HTTP attempt count may remain unknown.
Global profile and original four questions are preserved; no newly supplied Intent or retrieval hits.
